entities.name: Androzani Minor
entities.description: Desert planet with boiling mud bursts and caves, home of spectrox.

entities.name: Androzani Major
entities.description: Companion planet colonized by humans in preference to Androzani Minor.

entities.name: Spectrox
entities.description: Drug on Androzani Minor that grants near-eternal life.

events.summary: Humans take an interest in Androzani Minor after discovering spectrox.
events.quote: It wasn't until the humans discovered that Androzani Minor contained a drug in spectrox
